units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4<sup>20</sup></cite> <he>ואל … ש׳ בעיני וכ׳</he> say not that I was low in the eyes of others, and was not despised in my own eyes.
Taan. 16ᵃ; Snh. 88ᵇ, a. e. שְׁפַל ברך low of knee, polite. Y. ib. I, 19ᶜ נפש ש׳ a humble soul, humility; Ab. V, 19 נפש ש׳ contented, opp. רחבה.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:10">Ib. IV, 10</cite> <he>הוי שְׁ׳ רוח בפני וכ׳</he> be humble before every man.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 43b:2">Snh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>מי שדעתו ש׳ מעלה וכ׳</he> to him whose mind is lowly the Lord accounts it as if he had offered all kinds of sacrifices.

<cite ref="Sotah 5a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אבל … ורואה את הש׳</he> but not so the Lord, he is high and looks at the low; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01706"><he>שְׁפָלִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01706"><he>שְׁפָלִין</he></cite>; <cite ref="U01778"><he>שְׁפָלוֹת</he></cite>. Ib. 47ᵇ, v. <cite ref="C00049"><he>גָּבַהּ</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (v. שָׁפֵל, Hithpa.) [letting the hands sink,] indolent, negligent, opp. זָרִיז.
units: Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8; Pes. 50ᵇ יש ש׳ וכ׳ sometimes one is lazy and profits, and sometimes one is lazy and loses.—Pl. as ab.
